name: Shirmani Global Social Platform Core
purpose: Evidence-aware architecture for a global social platform where people can create accounts, publish, listen, watch, learn, connect and participate voluntarily.
scale_target: 850 crore people as an architectural target; not a claim of current capacity.
integrity_rules: No fabricated accounts, people, followers, views, likes, comments, payments, employment, testimonials or income.
AI assistance does not constitute proof of a real-world event, transaction, identity or personal experience.
Consequential moderation, identity disputes, appeals, payment disputes and liability decisions require documented human review where applicable.
Users retain clear privacy, audience, export and deletion controls.
Growth mechanisms must not depend on deception, coercion or concealed manipulation.
Global-scale readiness requires real infrastructure, security, privacy, observability, disaster recovery and load testing evidence.
